name: pcb-lens
description: Query IPC-2581 PCB layout files for physical design review
long_description:
The PCB Lens MCP Server gives AI agents the power to query and analyze PCB layouts from IPC-2581 files. Get design overviews, find component placements, trace net routing, and read layout constraints through natural conversations.

Supports IPC-2581 XML files (RevA, RevB, RevC) exported from any compliant EDA tool, and Cadence .tcfx constraint files. On Windows with Cadence SPB installed, Allegro .brd files can be exported to both formats in place.

tools.name: get_pcb_metadata
tools.description: Get an overview of an IPC-2581 PCB design file: file metadata, layer stackup, design units, and component/net counts

tools.name: get_pcb_component
tools.description: Look up a single component by exact refdes. Returns placement (position, rotation, layer), package and BOM details, the nets on each pin, and a pad summary.

tools.name: get_pcb_net
tools.description: Look up nets by name pattern. Returns connected pins, per-layer routing (trace widths, segment counts, routed length), and via information.

tools.name: get_constraints
tools.description: Query layout constraints from a Cadence .tcfx file: physical and spacing constraint sets, net classes, stackup, and regions

tools.name: export_cadence_ipc2581
tools.description: Export a Cadence Allegro .brd file to IPC-2581 XML, the format the query tools read (Windows only, requires Cadence SPB)

tools.name: export_cadence_constraints
tools.description: Export the design rules from a Cadence Allegro .brd file to a .tcfx file for get_constraints to read (Windows only, requires Cadence SPB)
